test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five candidates, J, K, L, M and N are sitting in the same row, facing north waiting to be interviewed by the HR Manager. N is to the left of K. L is an immediate neighbor of both K and J. If J is fourth from the left, then how far is N from the right?
solution:
**Five candidates -** J, K, L, M and N are sitting in the same row, facing north waiting to be interviewed by the HR Manager. 

1. J is fourth from the left.

2. L is an immediate neighbor of both K and J. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab20bb299239cf842f3cc639c0df9598a37bff7d08ebbff73371cc26004e5302.png] 

3. N is to the left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64960a19fe4e3dcacd96217dc05d0082a4866185256aa3a9d0d9b53e3525bde1.png] 

M, the only remaining person will occupy the vacant position.

The final arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e749bdf1d38877ee45236093e10418820d4c02e552fc5efdd045989b3472f88e.png] 

Clearly, N is 5th from the right.

Hence, '**5****th**** from the right**' is the correct answer.
